title: Nourishing Jamaican Pork Curry
description: A rich and creamy Jamaican curry featuring pork, fennel seeds, and a blend of spices, perfect for a special occasion or a comforting meal. This dish is free from animal by-products and is suitable for a Buddhist temple gathering.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the pork and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and fennel seeds and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the pork is tender, about 20 minutes.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
